description: Session lifecycle hooks for Claude Code Companion. The stop-time review gate is NOT wired here: Codex has no `Stop` hook event (its vocabulary is PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, PreCompact, PostCompact, SessionStart, SessionEnd, UserPromptSubmit, SubagentStart, SubagentStop). Wire the gate through `notify` in ~/.codex/config.toml instead — see README.
